purpose.zh: 练大腿和屁股，单腿也站得稳
purpose.en: Builds your thighs and butt so you feel steady on one leg.

text.zh: 往后退一大步，两腿弯到后膝快碰地
text.en: Take a big step back and bend both knees until the back knee nearly touches

text.zh: 前膝在脚踝正上方，上身直着稍微往前倾。
text.en: Front knee over your ankle, body tall with a slight lean.

text.zh: 前脚后跟踩地站起来，后脚收回，再换另一条腿。
text.en: Push through your front heel to stand, bring the back foot in, then switch legs.

text.zh: 左腿退一步、右腿退一步，合起来记 1 下。
text.en: Step back with each leg, and that pair is one.

commonErrors.zh: 落下去时前膝往里歪，前脚跟抬起来
commonErrors.en: Front knee falling in and front heel lifting as you drop.

cautions.zh: 膝盖不舒服就蹲浅点，还疼就停；站不稳就一手扶椅子
cautions.en: If your knees feel off, don't go as low. Stop if it still hurts. Wobbly? Hold a chair with one hand.
